title: Roving Elves
start: Talk to Islwyn, a roving elf somewhere in the elven forest of Isafdar in Tirannwn.

items.t: A rope (not necessary if you have built a rope rack)
A key to the Waterfall Dungeon (can be acquired during the quest)
Glarial's amulet (can be acquired during the quest)

recommended.t: Food, restore potions and combat stat-boosting potions
Two summer pies or agility potions/flasks if your Agility level is below 56
Means of getting to Ardougne (e.g. Ardougne Teleport, spirit trees, Ardougne cloak)
Means of getting to Camelot (e.g. Camelot Teleport, Seers' Village Teleport)
Means of getting to Tirannwn (e.g. money for charter ships)
A few antipoison potions in case you trip the traps

kills.t: Moss giant (level 24) You may not use any weapons, runes, summoning familiars, armour or prayer. Some exceptions for weapons if you are crafty.

rewards.t: A used crystal bow or crystal ward (your choice, it will be 20% charged).

steps.t: Track down and talk to Islwyn. [Chat: Accept › 1 Tell the truth? › 1 Maybe I could help.]

sub.t: Islwyn and Eluned move locations regularly: either south-west of Lletya or north-east of the Tyras Camp. Simply hop worlds until you find them.

p: A map of Isafdar - click to enlarge

steps.t: Use Glarial's pebble on Glarial's tombstone north-west of the Fishing Guild.

sub.t: If you're holding any combat equipment or logs, you'll receive the message: It fits perfectly, but nothing happens.
If needed, reclaim Glarial's pebble from Golrie in Gnome Village Dungeon. [Chat: 1 Yes please!]
You can also reclaim Glarial's pebble from the Storage Chest in May's Quest Caravan.

steps.t: Kill a moss giant and pick up the consecration seed it drops.

sub.t: You can remove an item from your tool belt to use as a weapon. Legacy combat mode increases auto attack damage. A ring of recoil may be helpful for lower levelled players.

steps.t: If needed, reclaim Glarial's amulet from the chest to the west.
Take the seed to Eluned to have her enchant it.

sub.t: Via hoardstalker ring or Dungeoneering cape (Baxtorian Falls resource dungeon option, called Waterfall fire giant dungeon in the cape)
Via games necklace, Barbarian Outpost then run south to Baxtorian Falls, then:
Board the log raft north of Baxtorian falls
Use a rope on the rock south across the water
Use a rope on the dead tree

steps.t: If needed, reclaim a key from the discoloured crates in the eastern room with skeletons.
Go inside the north-west room with the statues.
Plant the enchanted consecration seed anywhere inside.
Return to Islwyn to choose your reward. [Chat: Any]
